**🚀 Frank is back — and you can go to space with him.**
Our mission launchpad and competition have reopened today.

▶️ Watch the launch: https://x.com/OfficialMoonDAO/status/2075260317651878242

Who is Frank? For over four decades, Frank has interviewed more than 50 astronauts and coined a term that changed the world: the Overview Effect. Today, we’re recommitting to send him to space.

@everyone: Important Fundraiser Update!

We've made some updates to the overview flight terms and conditions based on a few pieces of new information:

- Some of the funds we’ve raised so far have come in off-chain (checks), while others have been direct ETH contributions through the website.
- Our current refund language only references the ETH committed to the contract, with refunds calculated solely on on-chain ETH raised after the fundraise ends.
- We may be able to negotiate a seat for Frank at a discounted price.

To make things fairer for every supporter, we’re changing the refund criteria to include **both** on-chain and off-chain contributions. **We’re also committing to negotiate a flight for Frank regardless of the final amount raised.** Our team will take **one month after the fundraise closes** to secure at least one seat for Frank to go to space. If we’re unable to secure that seat by then, all refunds will be processed through the MoonDAO platform.

For those who have competed for a second seat, if we do not reach the minimum goal of two stratospheric balloon tickets we will complete the competition with the winner getting a zero gravity flight or something equivalent depending on how much we raise.

You can view the updated terms and conditions here:
​https://docs.moondao.com/Legal/Overview-Effect-Flight/Overview-Effect-Flight-Terms-and-Conditions​

This is all just in case we don't reach our goal, but we will push hard to achieve our goal of sending frank to space!!
